prompts: Edit the attached pixel-art game spider, preserving exactly its silhouette, limb layout, proportions, pose, composition and three-quarter side view facing left with its single visible eye. This is a palette and marking edit only. Turn the entire white and gold spider into a plain warm chestnut brown spider with deep chocolate outlines and stepped warm medium-brown pixel shading. REMOVE ALL ornamental markings: no gold forehead emblem, no gold abdomen chevron or crest, no gold stripes, no gold leg bands or gold tips. Those regions must blend into the plain brown shading of the surrounding body or leg, without leaving the pattern visible. Preserve the cute expression and original anatomy exactly. Clean crisp square pixel-art edges, no blur, no smooth gradients, no glow. Isolated full spider, same framing, transparent background.

No shapes, V patterns, inner borders, rings, mottling, stripes or central emblems anywhere inside either body lobe. Do not keep the old pattern as brown shading. Transparent background. Only simplify the body surface; no anatomical changes.
